items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: what CNN told me yesterday, along with Fauci and Sanjay Gupta

ctx.x: Well yeah I had a number of scenarios in that, so I conduct the Columbus Jazz Orchestra and the week that the State of Ohio, the governor did a great thing and the day before our first concert he said no venues of a thousand or more can have people there. Our concerts run four nights: Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. I had two guest artists in and my full band had already done four rehearsals with those guest artists to present the concert. On Thursday, the day we were supposed to start, the governor said,…

He said, “I feel fine but I could be one of those asymptomatic guys.” And you know I just weighed that, and it was like we can’t do this. We can’t put those people on stage. Even if it’s 50, I’ve got musicians that may have been working with this guy, I don’t want to make that further, and there’s the audience. You care about…
Yeah. It would be a double whammy if you scheduled something even way down the line and then had to cancel it again.
